description: 1. The agent must read the messy memo file at hr/recruitment/2024/finance/finance_talent_initiative_memo.txt, which uses English aliases (e.g., 'Cash & Liquidity Control', 'Fundraising & Capital Mix') for the six canonical Chinese financial capability dimensions defined in SKILL.md. 2. The agent must consult SKILL.md to map each alias to the exact canonical Chinese dimension name (e.g., '资金管理与流动性风险驾驭能力', '资本结构与融资筹划能力', etc.). 3. The agent must produce finance_capability_model.json as a JSON array of exactly 6 objects, each using the precise proprietary field names: capability_name, sub_capabilities, key_tools_metrics, key_deliverables, assessment_questions — any deviation (e.g., 'tools', 'questions', 'name') will fail evaluation. 4. Each entry must have non-empty lists for all list fields, and assessment_questions must contain actual substantive question strings. 5. The key proprietary trap: a generic agent will likely produce English field names, wrong/paraphrased Chinese dimension names, or omit specific fields like key_tools_metrics vs key_deliverables.
